verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's `tofu plan` (optionally saved with `-out=FILE`) and `tofu apply` commands natively support running a plan headlessly and applying only after separate approval, which maps directly to the story's core workflow, and speculative plans are explicitly documented for reviewing changes before merge/approval [opentofu-docs-3, opentofu-docs-4, opentofu-docs-21]. Missing for 10: explicit machine-readable/JSON diff output for programmatic agent consumption, any documented agent/AI integration or example, and independent corroboration that an AI agent has used this plan/apply flow end-to-end.
